name: mask_flame
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A standalone 2D game VFX sprite for a Persona 5 Joker mod: bold hand-painted anime/comic shapes, clean controlled ink accents, high contrast, no 3D or photorealism. GENUINE TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG: alpha zero outside the actual sprite; never paint a dark backdrop, colored haze, vignette, checkerboard or ground. Soft glow must taper to transparent at the outer edge. Keep the whole sprite inside the canvas with transparent margin, no clipping. No text, watermark, characters or additional objects. Front view of Joker's upswept phantom-thief eye mask formed ONLY by a narrow outline of upward-licking CYAN BLUE FLAME, bright white flame core and cyan/blue edges. Two upturned outer pointed corners and upward swept eye shapes. Entire mask interior and BOTH eye holes fully transparent, not a solid mask, no face. Canvas 1024x640 pixels.
processing: 保留raw；交付尺寸归一化，alpha<=2残点及全透明RGB清零；未抠底。
